notes: Starting cards as marked '(start)' in the list: You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed (posted 'Objective YCEPBT/OBD'), Han (Jedi Pack), Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, Insurrection, Staging Areas, Heading For The Medical Frigate; Squadron Assignments is marked 'normally start' and Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice 'start against BHBM/Huntdown'. These count toward the 60. Several Effects start, so no single starting Effect is set.
Section headers as posted do not all match their lists: 'Charcters21' lists 20 characters and 'Interrupts11' lists 12 interrupts. The list is kept as published; it totals 60.
Posted 'G. S. 3' is kept as written (UNKNOWN): no card is named Gold Squadron 3. Best guess: Gold 3 (Special Edition Y-wing), by analogy with 'R. S. 1' = Red Squadron 1.
The sixth location is posted only as 'DB' (besides 'TDB 94'); which docking bay is not named, so it is kept as posted (UNKNOWN), as in the author's later Profit deck.

Posted 'Roller Skate' dested Pulsar Skate; 'R. S. 1' Red Squadron 1; 'Artoo' Artoo (Jabba's Palace); 'TJabba's Palace' the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Tattoine' Tatooine (Light) (Premiere); 'Massa Luke' Master Luke; 'WARSL' Wedge Antilles, Red Squadron Leader; 'Obi's Stick' / 'Ani's Stick' Obi-Wan's Lightsaber / Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Squadron Assignments' the printed Death Star II effect (not the (V)).
